items.source: By default, URI parsing is based on the RFC parser type, which expects input strings to conform to RFC 3986 syntax. The alternative WhatWG parser type, based on the algorithm from the WhatWG URL Living Standard provides more lenient handling of a wide range of cases that occur in user types URL's.
items.translation: 默认情况下，URI 解析基于RFC 解析器类型，该解析器期望输入字符串符合 RFC 3986 语法。替代方案是WhatWG 解析器类型，它基于 WhatWG URL 活标准中的算法，提供了对用户输入 URL 中出现的各种情况的更宽松处理。

items.source: In comparison to UriComponents.encode(), this method has the same effect on the URI template, i.e. each URI component is encoded by replacing non-ASCII and illegal (within the URI component type) characters with escaped octets. However URI variables are encoded more strictly, by also escaping characters with reserved meaning.
items.translation: 与UriComponents.encode()相比，此方法对 URI 模板具有相同的效果，即通过将非 ASCII 字符和非法（在 URI 组件类型内）字符替换为转义八进制数来编码每个 URI 组件。然而，URI 变量的编码更为严格，还会转义具有保留含义的字符。

items.source: For most cases, this method is more likely to give the expected result because in treats URI variables as opaque data to be fully encoded, while UriComponents.encode() is useful when intentionally expanding URI variables that contain reserved characters.
items.translation: 对于大多数情况，此方法更有可能给出预期结果，因为它将 URI 变量视为需要完全编码的不透明数据，而UriComponents.encode()在有意扩展包含保留字符的 URI 变量时很有用。

items.source: For example ';' is legal in a path but has reserved meaning. This method replaces ";" with "%3B" in URI variables but not in the URI template. By contrast, UriComponents.encode() never replaces ";" since it is a legal character in a path.
items.translation: 例如，';' 在路径中是合法的，但具有保留含义。此方法仅在 URI 变量中将 ';' 替换为 "%3B"，而不在 URI 模板中进行替换。相比之下，UriComponents.encode() 永远不会替换 ';'，因为它是路径中的合法字符。

items.source: When not expanding URI variables at all, prefer use of UriComponents.encode() since that will also encode anything that incidentally looks like a URI variable.
items.translation: 当完全不展开 URI 变量时，优先使用 UriComponents.encode()，因为它也会编码任何偶然看起来像 URI 变量的内容。

items.source: Note: encoding, if applied, will only encode characters that are illegal in a query parameter name or value such as "=" or "&". All others that are legal as per syntax rules in RFC 3986 are not encoded. This includes "+" which sometimes needs to be encoded to avoid its interpretation as an encoded space. Stricter encoding may be applied by using a URI template variable along with stricter encoding on variable values. For more details please read the "URI Encoding" section of the Spring Framework reference.
items.translation: 注意： 如果应用编码，则仅对查询参数名称或值中非法的字符（例如 "=" 或 "&"）进行编码。所有符合RFC 3986语法规则的合法字符均不进行编码。这包括有时需要编码以避免被解释为已编码空格的 "+"。可以通过使用 URI 模板变量以及对变量值应用更严格的编码来实施更严格的编码。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 Spring Framework 参考中的"URI 编码"部分。
